payload.description:
As a dispatcher I assume any agentic invocation may empty the rest of the window. I therefore run at most one live spot job per pool, re-probe after each chore, and treat wall-clock or turn caps as hints not guarantees.

Feature: burn remaining
  Scenario: second job does not start while first is live
    Given a spare Claude weekly pool
    And a spot run is already live on that pool
    When Spotticus dispatches
    Then it does not start another run on that pool

  Scenario: re-probe after a chore
    Given a spare pool that a finished chore then exhausts
    When Spotticus considers the next chore
    Then it does not dispatch on the stale snapshot
payload.title: One live spot run per pool; assume a run may burn remaining quota
